title: Signature First Breath Garden
concept: A delivery suite opening onto a private garden where the family steps out together for the baby's first daylight. Birth ends in nature, not fluorescent light. Concept by Manon.
improvement_over_conventional: Improves on windowless delivery rooms with a garden first-moment.
patient_flow: Mothers arrive in OB triage for assessment; true labor admits to a labor room with continuous support. Nurses monitor contractions and fetal heart tones, providers manage progress, and delivery happens in-room or in the OR for C-sections. After birth, mother and baby room in together with lactation support until discharge teaching sends the new family home.
code_demo:
# Signature First Breath Garden — Signature design prototype
def due_date(lmp_month, lmp_day, lmp_year):
    """Naegele's rule: LMP + 7 days - 3 months + 1 year."""
    d = lmp_day + 7; m = lmp_month - 3; y = lmp_year
    if m <= 0: m += 12
    else: y += 1
    if d > 30: d -= 30; m += 1
    return f"Estimated due date: {m}/{d}/{y}"
print(due_date(1, 10, 2026))
teaching: Simple: the core idea in plain words — what it is and why it matters.
